strategy.primary: cEDH graveyard replay: Kess recasts one instant or sorcery from the graveyard each turn, so one Demonic Consultation or Tainted Pact finds Thassa's Oracle and is replayed to win, and Intuition/Gifts Ungiven piles win on any split.
strategy.secondary: Underworld Breach finishes (Grinding Station with a zero-cost artifact, LED + Brain Freeze/Wheel), with loot and self-mill (Faithless Looting, Dragon's Rage Channeler, Entomb) stocking the yard.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Kess, Dissident Mage
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Flying
Once during each of your turns, you may cast an instant or sorcery spell from your graveyard. If a spell cast this way would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.

identity.why: Once-per-turn instant/sorcery replay from the graveyard.
Cast twice with Kess: find Oracle, then win.
Every split wins with Kess's permission unused.
Resets Kess for another graveyard cast.
